verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents a desktop app on macOS, Windows and Linux, with tabs and multi-session support for running several agents in parallel on the same project. That covers the multiple-sessions half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows visual diff review in the desktop app, and tabs are not shown to give a true side-by-side layout. Missing for 10: documented visual diff review in the desktop app, evidence of side-by-side (split) session layout rather than tabs, independent hands-on corroboration of desktop multi-session use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review diffs visually and run multiple sessions side by side in a desktop app

citations.quote: Introducing tabs for desktop. Available on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
